content: The most popular method of acquiring translation examples is bilingual text alignment BIBREF5 . This kind of method can be classified into two types: lexical-based and statistical-based. The lexical-based approaches BIBREF6 , BIBREF7 focus on lexical information, which utilize the bilingual dictionary BIBREF8 , BIBREF9 or lexical features. Meanwhile, the statistical-based approaches BIBREF10 , BIBREF11 rely on statistical information, such as sentence length ratio in two languages and align mode probability.
